mapper.sql: id, order_number, total_amount, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.total_amount, o.status, o.created_at, o.updated_at, oi.id AS oi_id, oi.quantity, oi.price, oi.order_id, oi.book_id, b.id AS b_id, b.title AS b_title, b.author AS b_author, b.price AS b_price, b.stock AS b_stock, b.sales AS b_sales, b.category AS b_category, b.isbn AS b_isbn, b.description AS b_description, b.created_at AS b_created_at, b.updated_at AS b_updated_at FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN book b ON oi.book_id = b.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.total_amount, o.status, o.created_at, o.updated_at, oi.id AS oi_id, oi.quantity, oi.price, oi.order_id, oi.book_id, b.id AS b_id, b.title AS b_title, b.author AS b_author, b.price AS b_price, b.stock AS b_stock, b.sales AS b_sales, b.category AS b_category, b.isbn AS b_isbn, b.description AS b_description, b.created_at AS b_created_at, b.updated_at AS b_updated_at FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN book b ON oi.book_id = b.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_number, total_amount, status) VALUES (#{orderNumber}, #{totalAmount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET total_amount=#{totalAmount}, status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
